_note: Response to gap-closure item #11 (Bilahari). raga_metadata.json is explicitly Hindustani-focused (sourced from Raga List.xlsx, framework: hindustani_classical_musicology). Bilahari is a Carnatic raga referenced in chakra_raga_bridge.json's research-supported evidence (Ramachandran et al. 2022, Heliyon -- a real peer-reviewed study on Carnatic raga-Bilahari and anxiety/sleep/somatic symptoms in cancer caregivers). Per project instruction Section 7 ('Do not create a fake Hindustani equivalent... preserve as a separate Carnatic entity rather than forcing it into the wrong taxonomy'), this file creates a small, separate Carnatic-raga structure rather than inventing Bilahari vadi/samvadi/thaat fields inside the Hindustani-schema raga_metadata.json.

ragas.melakarta_parent: 29 (Dheera Shankarabharanam) -- per raga_hindustani_carnatic_equivalents.json, which lists Bilahari as the Carnatic raga corresponding to melakarta 29 in two separate rows
ragas.hindustani_equivalents_caveat: The equivalents table gives TWO different Hindustani ragas (with two different thaat numbers, 2 and 3) as corresponding to the same Carnatic raga Bilahari. This is an internal inconsistency in that source table, not resolved by this pass -- flagged rather than silently picking one. A musicologist should confirm whether this reflects a genuine one-to-many relationship (plausible, since Hindustani/Carnatic correspondence is by underlying note-set, not a strict 1:1 mapping) or a source error.
ragas.field_status: aroha/avaroha/mood/time fields not_found -- no Carnatic-musicology source available to this pass (no web access)

therapeutic_research.study: Ramachandran, K., Rajkumar, E., Romate, J., Allen, J. G., & Daniel, M. (2022). Effect of Carnatic raga-Bilahari based music therapy on anxiety, sleep disturbances and somatic symptoms among caregivers of cancer patients. Heliyon, 8(9), e10681.
therapeutic_research.result_summary: Statistically significant (p<0.001) decrease in anxiety, sleep disturbance, somatic symptoms, and distress after a month of raga-Bilahari listening (vocal/instrumental, alternating days, 15-30 min).
therapeutic_research.evidence_level: LEVEL_1 (peer-reviewed clinical research, per this project's evidence scale)
therapeutic_research.note: This study links Bilahari to a therapeutic OUTCOME (anxiety/sleep/somatic symptoms), not to any chakra. Do not infer a chakra association from this entry -- see chakra_raga_bridge.json's own explicit separation of raga-research from chakra-mapping.
